brief:
Amichai Eliyahu, an Israeli minister, made derogatory remarks about Palestinians and Muslims in parliament, referring to them as "camel riders" and "barbarians," Middle East Eye reported. The comments occurred amid what the outlet describes as a growing campaign of incitement against Palestinian citizens of Israel.

The remarks came from a government official during parliamentary debate, as tensions between Israeli authorities and the Palestinian population within Israel's borders remain high.

title: Israeli minister calls Palestinians and Muslims 'camel riders' and 'barbarians'
